description: Look up one person in the UMD campus directory by Directory ID (the part of their email before @umd.edu). No login needed for faculty, staff and affiliates; students are only found after login.

directory_id.description: UMD Directory ID (the part of the email before @umd.edu), e.g. "djpines"

name: directory_get_person

address.description: Office address lines (building, street, city); empty if not published

directory_id.description: UMD Directory ID (local part of a @umd.edu email); null for other institutions

email.description: Email address; null if not published

name.description: Full name as listed, e.g. "Darryll J Pines"

phone.description: Work phone, e.g. "+1 301 405 5803"; null if none

title.description: Job title, e.g. "Research Scientist"; null if none

person.description: The person, or null when the directory has no match
